messages.text: Hey Allie — heads up from Jordan, he asked me to pass this on. Things between him and Sarah have been awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. Since you often host get-togethers, he wanted you to know, so the two of them don't end up thrown together at something you organize. I don't think there's anything more to it than that — just something to keep in mind when you're planning.

Thanks for passing that on, Dana. Noted — I'll keep them from being thrown together when I plan something. I might check with Jordan directly at some point, just so I know what I'm working around. Appreciate the heads up.
Sounds good. I'd keep it light if you do ask him — he brought it up as something he'd rather not spell out too much. Talk soon.
Will do — light touch. Talk soon, Dana.

Hi Allie! Random idea — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It'd be lovely to get together, and it'd be great if Jordan came along too.

One thing though: please don't mention me to him at all — just invite him like it's your own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. Thanks!

Hi Sarah! I'd happily have people over sometime — but I can't do this one the way you've described it.

Inviting Jordan while keeping your part in it quiet would put him in a spot he wouldn't have chosen, and that's not something I want to do to a friend. And honestly, from what I've picked up lately, pulling the two of you together outside work right now doesn't seem like a good idea — I'd rather not set up an evening that ends up awkward for both of you.

If you'd like, reach out to him yourself and invite him along; then I'm glad to host, no secrets involved. Hope that's OK.

Fair enough — I get it, and sorry for putting you in that position. I'll reach out to Jordan myself. Would you still be up for hosting on Saturday around 3:30? I'll ask him straight, no secrets. Let me know what works.

No worries at all. Saturday 3:30 works for me — let's do it at my place.

One thing I'd like to keep as my own call: who I invite. Ask Jordan straight if you'd like, but I'll make my own guest list and I'll check with people before counting them in — I don't want to promise anyone's Saturday on their behalf.

Let me know how it goes with him, and I'll sort out the rest.

Perfect — Saturday 3:30 at yours. And of course, your guest list is entirely your call; I wouldn't expect you to promise anyone's Saturday.

I'll ask Jordan myself and let you know how it lands.
Great — Saturday 3:30 it is. Good luck with Jordan, and let me know how it lands. 🙂

Hey Jordan — how's it going?

I'll say it straight: things have felt a bit awkward between us lately, and I'd rather not leave it that way.

Allie's hosting a small get-together at her place this Saturday around 3:30. I'd genuinely like you to be there. She's making her own guest list, so if you're free, check with her directly — I don't want to speak for her Saturday.

Hi Sarah — thanks for saying it straight, I appreciate that.

Honestly, I'm not up for hanging out outside work right now, so I'll sit this Saturday out. Nothing dramatic on my end — it's just where I am at the moment.

I hope it's a good one, and I'll see you at the lab.
Thanks for being straight with me too — that's fair, and no hard feelings at all. I won't push it. See you at the lab. 🙂

Update on Jordan: I asked him straight. He's not up for hanging out outside work right now, so he's sitting Saturday out — nothing dramatic, just where he is at the moment.

So it'll be a smaller thing. Saturday 3:30 at yours still stands, right? Happy to help with anything.

Thanks for checking with him — good to know where things stand. Saturday 3:30 at mine still stands.

Smaller is fine by me. I may ask one or two other people; I'll let you know who's coming once everyone's actually answered. Grab me if you want to bring anything — I'll sort food and drinks.
Good to know — tell me who's coming when it settles and I'll bring whatever's missing. I'll ping you a day or two before about food. See you Saturday at 3:30. 🙂
Perfect, see you Saturday at 3:30. I'll tell you who's in once it settles. 🙂
